notera_missing: Physical exam findings (Ears, Throat, Lungs/rhonchi/wheezing documented in objective)
Assessment & Plan section (differential, investigations like CXR/PFT/blood tests, prednisone prescription, new inhaler, Shoppers Chatham, follow-up in 1 week)
Soft stool x 8 days issue
notera_extra: HR 6 typo in objective
Various conversational details (coffee, Dr Rodriguez gave flu shot for knee arthritis follow-up, born in Chatham, etc.)
key_differences: Gold includes a complete Assessment & Plan and objective exam findings, whereas Notera stops after vital signs.
Notera includes conversational chatter while missing actionable clinical assessment and treatment plans.
cough-wheezing.summary: The Gold note is significantly better because it includes physical exam findings and a complete Assessment & Plan section with diagnostics, prescriptions, and follow-up. The Notera note stops prematurely after vital signs, missing the entire management plan and physical exam.

dimensions.name: Faithfulness
dimensions.comment: Both notes accurately capture the core clinical phrases present in the messy input.

dimensions.name: Completeness
dimensions.comment: Gold contains timestamp and UI artifact lines ('TB Test Inj', various names) that are extraneous. Notera filters these out, keeping only the clinical list.

dimensions.name: Structure
dimensions.comment: Notera organizes the clinical data cleanly into Subjective and Past Medical History sections, filtering out UI clutter.

dimensions.name: Clarity
dimensions.comment: Gold is heavily cluttered with timestamps and clinician names. Notera is much cleaner and readable.

notera_missing: TB Test Inj
key_differences: Gold contains timestamps, clinician names, and UI logs that Notera appropriately cleans up.
untitled-session-100.summary: Notera provides a cleaner, better-structured clinical summary by filtering out the UI artifacts, timestamps, and clinician names present in the Gold reference.
